Carpet care tips

  • Vacuum high-traffic areas at least weekly.
  • Blot spills straight away with a dry cloth — rubbing spreads them and pushes them deeper.
  • Rotate rugs every few months so they wear evenly.
  • To estimate the cost, multiply length by width in feet, then by the per-sq-ft rate.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does carpet cleaning cost per sq ft in Bhopal?

At Cleanzit, carpet cleaning starts at ₹16+ per sq ft, and at-home carpet cleaning starts at ₹16 per sq ft.

How do I work out my carpet's size?

Multiply length by width in feet. A 5 × 8 ft rug is 40 sq ft.
